topic: Hand off a real task: turn a folder of receipts into an expense report with Claude Cowork
post:
Still typing receipts into a spreadsheet by hand? 🧾
Let Claude Cowork build the expense report for you.

"Drop receipts in a folder and ask Claude to create a formatted expense report" is one of the example tasks in Claude's own Cowork guide.

(Cowork is the mode where Claude works with your files for you, instead of just chatting.)

Step by step 👇
1️⃣ Put this month's receipts in one folder
2️⃣ Open Claude and select Cowork in the message box
3️⃣ Share ONLY that folder
4️⃣ Paste the prompt below
5️⃣ Review Claude's plan, then let it run

Copy this prompt:
"Read every receipt in this folder. Create an Excel expense report with date, vendor, category, and amount, plus a total. Flag any receipt you can't read clearly. Don't change or delete the original files."

Then check it ✅
Spot-check a few rows against the receipts before you submit. You're still the one signing off.

📌 Cowork needs a paid plan (Pro, Max, Team or Enterprise).

Why it matters:
The boring admin task is the perfect first handoff. Low risk, easy to check, and real time back in your week. 💡
